title: Review an open campaign each day

steps.do: Count the leads and replies that came in since the campaign started, by channel, and compare them with the campaign's goal.
For each new lead with no first response, write the opportunity and draft the reply for the founder to send.
When responses fall short of the goal's pace, propose to the growth lead one change to the message or the channel for tomorrow.

done_criteria.check: Does every lead that came in during the campaign have an opportunity and a reply sent or drafted?
